about: Provenance for everything the island draws (brief §8 'Sourcing and processing'). No external texture, model, HDRI, font or audio file was downloaded or shipped: the brief's Poly Haven / Kenney entries were candidates only, and every visual below is generated in this repository. The only third-party code the island adds is from the three.js package already pinned in package.json.
checkedHow: rg for TextureLoader / GLTFLoader / image, model and audio extensions under src/client/world and src/world (none); the world's only fetches are same-origin /world-data/ files written by scripts/world/build-world.ts

generated.visual: landmark timber (20 landmarks, B/M/D stock pieces)
generated.source: src/world/recipes/*.ts, src/world/orders.ts, src/world/parts.ts (recipes authored from the brief's Appendix B; references explain inspiration only)
generated.output: dist/client/world-data/landmarks/L??.<hash>.bin and L??.far.<hash>.bin (SWLM v3 / SWLF v1, src/world/format.ts)

generated.source: src/client/world/materials.ts timberMaterial / chainMaterial (shader noise, no image)

generated.output: dist/client/world-data/terrain.<hash>.bin (heights, decoded into chunks on the client)

generated.source: src/client/world/environment.ts rockGeometries (displaced icosahedra), materials.ts rockMaterial (triplanar shader noise)

thirdPartyCode.name: three.js OrbitControls
thirdPartyCode.use: development inspector camera (/world/inspect/, test flag only)
thirdPartyCode.modifications: none; its document key listener is removed explicitly on dispose (docs/evidence/world/memory-incident.md §8)

audio: none added; the island has no sound
credits: README.md 'Island' section credits the three.js authors (MIT) for the Sky shader and OrbitControls; architectural references are listed in the brief's Appendix H and are inspiration, not sources of geometry or images.
